evidence.quote: most participants saw a reduction in the pace of purchases as appropriate at this meeting and consistent with the Committee's previous policy communications.
it likely will be appropriate to maintain the current target range for the federal funds rate well past the time that the unemployment rate declines below [RANGE] percent
many participants expressed concern about the deceleration in consumer prices over the past year

Committee participants generally viewed the increases in nonfarm payroll employment of more than 200,000 per month in [MONTH] and [MONTH] and the decline in the unemployment rate to 7 percent as encouraging signs
saw the risks associated with their forecasts of real GDP growth and the unemployment rate as more nearly balanced than earlier in the year
the Committee will likely reduce the pace of asset purchases in further measured steps at future meetings.

parsed.rationale: The minutes describe the start of tapering, with signals of further measured reductions, improving labor markets and more balanced risks, which is a hawkish lean. This is offset by strengthened dovish rate guidance and concern about low inflation, so the net signal is moderately hawkish.
